# Native Title Advice Memo (e2e fixture)

Native title was first recognised in *Mabo*.[^1] The principle was applied to
pastoral leases in *Wik*.[^2] Executive detention questions arose in the Tampa
litigation,[^3] and the limits of privative clauses were settled in *Plaintiff
S157*.[^4] The aliens power question was revisited in *Love*.[^5]

[^1]: Mabo v Queensland (No 2) [1992] 175 CLR 1.
[^2]: Wik Peoples v. Queensland (1996) 187 CLR 1.
[^3]: Ruddock v Vadarlis (2001) 110 F.C.R. 491.
[^4]: Plaintiff S157/2002 v Commonwealth (2003) 211 CLR 476, 492.
[^5]: Love v Commonwealth (2020) HCA 3.
